evals.prompt: Generate Lindkvist Anki CSV rows for: borsa, adesso, americano. Append them to ./output.csv in the working directory (create the file with the correct header if needed).
evals.expected_output: A CSV file output.csv with the Lindkvist 8-column header and at least one row each for borsa, adesso, and americano, with cloze markup, empty Audio, TTSSentence without cloze, and Italian-style Tags.
expectations: CSV has exact header Word;ExampleSentence;WordPOS;TranslationWord;TranslationSentence;TTSSentence;Audio;Tags
File contains at least one data row for each of borsa, adesso, and americano
Every ExampleSentence contains exactly one {{c1::…}} cloze marker
Audio field is empty on every data row
TTSSentence equals ExampleSentence with cloze markup stripped
Tags use Italian Lindkvist-style labels (e.g. sostantivo, avverbio, aggettivo)
Each data row has exactly 8 semicolon-separated fields

evals.prompt: Add Anki cards for these Italian verbs: fare, essere, dovere. Follow Lindkvist CSV rules (conjugated Word forms, not bare infinitives unless the cloze is truly infinitive). Write to ./verbs.csv.
evals.expected_output: A verbs.csv with correct header and rows where Word is conjugated (or infinitive only when the sentence teaches infinitive after a modal), WordPOS includes person/tense, Tags look like Lindkvist verb tags, Audio empty.
expectations: CSV has exact header Word;ExampleSentence;WordPOS;TranslationWord;TranslationSentence;TTSSentence;Audio;Tags
File contains rows covering fare, essere, and dovere (as conjugated forms or infinitive-after-modal)
Word column is not a bare infinitive unless WordPOS is verb, infinitive and the cloze teaches that infinitive
WordPOS for finite verbs includes person and/or tense detail
Tags use Italian verb-style labels (verbo …)
Every ExampleSentence contains {{c1::…}} and TTSSentence has no cloze markup
Audio field is empty on every data row

evals.prompt: I need cloze flashcards for the polysemous Italian word 'piano' and the phrase 'a partire da'. Put the rows in ./polysemy.csv using the Lindkvist Anki format.
evals.expected_output: A polysemy.csv with multiple rows for distinct senses of piano plus at least one row for a partire da; each row full 8 fields with {{c1::}} cloze and matching TTSSentence.
expectations: CSV has exact header Word;ExampleSentence;WordPOS;TranslationWord;TranslationSentence;TTSSentence;Audio;Tags
At least two distinct sense rows for piano (different TranslationWord and/or sentence meaning)
At least one row for a partire da
Every ExampleSentence contains {{c1::…}} wrapping the target
TTSSentence matches ExampleSentence with cloze markup removed
Audio field is empty on every data row
Each data row has exactly 8 semicolon-separated fields
